reading.title: Can empathy be taught?
reading.text: Some schools in Denmark have weekly lessons in empathy. Children discuss their problems and learn to understand how others feel. Supporters say these lessons reduce bullying and create a more sympathetic atmosphere in class. Critics argue that emotions cannot be taught like maths, and that the lessons take time away from academic subjects. Yet the alternative may be worse: studies link a lack of empathy in young adults to political apathy and to antipathy towards people who are different. Teaching children to care, supporters say, is not a waste of time.
